articles.title: Arsenal Smash Man City 3-0 in Season Opener!
articles.summary: Arsenal beat Manchester City 3-0 in the Community Shield. Riccardo Calafiori scored after just 24 seconds! New City boss Enzo Maresca had a rough first game.

articles.title: Tropical Storm Lala Soaks Hawaii with Huge Rain!
articles.summary: Tropical Storm Lala is dumping tons of rain on Hawaii. Over 130,000 homes lost power, and some places could get 35 inches of rain! One person died in a car crash.

articles.title: Thieves Steal Famous Renaissance Paintings in Sicily!
articles.summary: Thieves stole four super valuable paintings by Antonello da Messina from a museum in Sicily. The art is worth up to $92 million! Police are hunting for the robbers.
